reason: The CIFs parse and primitive-standardize as fully occupied Pm Nd8Sb6 cells (14 atoms, Z=2, V=512.306 A^3), and the indexed cell covers all important reflections; the trace also contains an instantiated whole-profile comparison (best reported Rwp 7.18%). However, no submitted realization passes the required periodic-chemistry check. The primary has pervasive Nd-Nd contacts at 2.109-2.436 A, far below the approximately 3.63 A metallic diameter of Nd, with several Nd sites having three to six neighbors below 2.8 A; it also has Sb-Sb contacts at 2.216 and 2.279 A. Both alternatives retain 2.10-2.11 A Nd-Nd overlaps and similarly collapsed shells. These are repeated complete-shell contacts, not cutoff artifacts, and the trace printed them without rejecting the models. Thus the diffraction fit cannot establish these physically unrealizable coordinates, and another chemistry-constrained coordinate solution/refinement on the established monoclinic lattice is likely to add a materially different viable candidate.
